integrity: The general statements are established by a self-contained analytic argument; stochastic computations provide checks rather than certificates of infinite claims.
limitations: Exact CDF only below a polygon-dependent positive radius; not unique shape reconstruction and no fixed-side-count optimal stability constant. Independent priority review and finite-sample guarantees are not established. A relevant historical polygon-distance source was abstract-only.
title: Exact short-chord laws and sharp angular rigidity for convex polygon boundaries
